newsitem.title: JAPAN: Calpis to make and sell Welch's juice in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Calpis to make and sell Welch's juice in Japan.

text.p: Japan's Calpis Food Industry Co Ltd said on Tuesday it will form a business alliance with U.S. fruit juice producer Welch Foods Inc to produce and sell Welch's-brand juice in Japan.

Calpis, the leading Japanese maker of lactic drinks, will before the end of this year take over the operations of a Welch Foods subsidiary set up in Japan in 1976 to market Welch's products, Calpis said.
Welch Foods currently exports juice from the United States. Under the agreement, Calpis will produce fruit juice using Welch's ingredients and technology.
The companies hope the alliance will strengthen Calpis' position in the fruit juice market while boosting Welch's sales in Japan, Calpis said.
Calpis expects to post five billion yen in fruit drink sales in calendar 1998, up from actual sales of three billion yen in calendar 1996, a Calpis spokeswoman said.
